complete_examples.text: For example, when the train speed is 250 km/h, it can be seen that the acceleration is in the range of 0.08–0.08 m/s2, while it increases to −0.2~0.2 m/s2 once the train speed reaches 400 km/h. Vibration acceleration level (VAL) is now used to study the ground vibration (international Standard ISO2631) at three soil observation points.
